page.title: Settings
page.purpose: Control locale, units, theme, accessibility, automation, and AI settings, and surface workspace data health so unsafe or incomplete state is visible before it causes a decision.

priorities.statement: The app remains fully usable with no model configured and says so rather than hiding the fallback.
Locale, currency, and display units are separate settings and changing a display unit never changes the underlying quantity.
Automation and notifications are opt-in, bounded, and reversible.
Data health reports orphaned or conflicting records and links to the transfer center for recovery.
Accessibility preferences such as reduced motion are honored and reachable by keyboard.

states.description: The surface at rest with data present; the state a journey step assumes when it names none.
First read of the page's data; layout is reserved so nothing shifts on arrival.
The read succeeded and there is genuinely nothing, which is distinct from not-yet-loaded.
Some contributing data could not be read; what is missing is named rather than shown as zero.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown.
The request failed; the reason and the next available action are stated.
Input was rejected before submission; the offending field is identified next to it.
A write is in flight; the affected control says why it is unavailable.
The client cannot reach the API; read-only or queued behavior is explained.
No model or credentialed provider is configured; the page states that manual entry and deterministic planning remain fully available.
The workspace data health report is shown with orphaned, conflicting, or unreferenced records named and linked to recovery.

elements.description: Locale, timezone, and currency, kept separate from display units.
Display units and currency presentation, which do not change stored quantities.
Honors the reduced-motion preference for page and selection motion.
Opt-in recurring draft generation and notification preferences in the profile timezone.
Whether an optional model adapter is configured.
Per-workspace automation budget and the requirement that a model outage never blocks core workflows.

elements.name: Data health
elements.description: Orphaned, conflicting, and unreferenced records across the workspace.
Per-record findings with a link to the owning surface or the transfer center.

elements.name: Your food, portable.
elements.description: Opens the transfer center for recovery and export.
The resumable setup draft, separate from active rules.
States that recipes, editing, plans, and export all remain available without a configured model.

claims.statement: With no provider configured, the page states that manual entry and deterministic planning remain fully available and never blocks a core workflow.
Locale, currency, and display units are separate settings, and changing a display unit does not change the underlying quantity.
Workspace data health names orphaned and conflicting records and links to the surface or transfer center that can resolve them.
The reduced-motion preference is available and honored across page and selection motion.
Theme, accessibility, and automation controls are fully keyboard reachable with visible focus.
Recurring drafts and notifications are opt-in, timezone-aware, and reversible, and a scheduled run never replaces an accepted plan.
A resumable setup draft is reported separately from active rules so an unfinished change is never treated as active.
The settings forms and data-health table never scroll the whole document sideways.
The transfer center is reachable from data health so a flagged record has a recovery path.
